focus_notes: Added a _RELATION_PRIORITY table to prioritize higher-information relations during edge collapse in undirected graphs.
Updated the logic for handling duplicate edges in `build_from_json` to ensure that the higher-priority relation wins the collapse, even if it arrives later.
Calls now survive over references when both are present on the same (src, tgt) pair during undirected graph edge collapse.
The deterministic order of edges by (source, target, relation) no longer results in lower-priority relations clobbering higher-priority ones.
Highest-priority relation survives collapse
Collapse outcome stable across input order for calls vs references
Updated the edge collapse policy to use a priority-based approach, ensuring that the last-write-wins rule is based on relation precedence rather than alphabetical sorting.
Maintained the single-edge invariant for undirected graphs by implementing the _RELATION_PRIORITY table.
